dct_description_sm: This project was part of the larger Nunavut Climate Change Partnership initiative, in which the Government of Nunavut, the Canadian Institute of Planners (CIP), Natural Resources Canada (NRCan), and Indian and Northern Affairs Canada worked together in climate change adaptation planning in Nunavut.  The objectives of this project were: -To disseminate information gathered by the Nunavut Climate Change Partnership initiative to communities in a universally accessible format; and -To share knowledge of 'lessons-learned' (from the partnership program) with members of the partnership, community members and policy-makers to increase the adaptive capacity within the Government of Nunavut.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Knowledge transfer
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Increasing Resilience and Adaptive Capacity Through Knowledge Sharing and Improved Communication
